SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.emp_id, e.empno AS empno, '관리자' AS dept, n.view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(n.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updated_date, n.status, n.use_yn, n.remark FROM notice n, emp e WHERE n.emp_id = e.emp_id AND NVL(n.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND ( n.status = '게시' OR #{role} = 'ADMIN' )
AND TRUNC(n.created_date) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(n.created_date) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ( n.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR n.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR 'MES 관리자' LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC
